unchanged_from_initial_F.hydraulic_family: C1R base MvG/KSATFIT N241 float32 bilinear log-mobility
unchanged_from_initial_F.candidate_algebra: identical to initial Gate F; one factorization plus one normal backsolve per accepted step

piecewise_route_policy.normal_route: If no state component changes N241 interpolation cell, accept under the original Gate F rules.
piecewise_route_policy.transition_route: If exactly one state component changes to exactly one adjacent N241 interpolation cell during an otherwise valid trial, accept the conservative trial as an explicit PIECEWISE_ADJACENT_CELL transition route. The Jacobian and all face derivatives for that trial remain those of the accepted start-state cells. No cross-node derivative is defined or averaged. The next step reassembles from the new accepted cell.
piecewise_route_policy.transition_detection: post-solve comparison of start and candidate table-cell indices; O(n) diagnostic work only
piecewise_route_policy.branch_count: one explicit branch count per accepted adjacent-cell transition trial
piecewise_route_policy.exact_node_endpoint: fail closed in F-R1 because no side tag is qualified here

explicit_nonclaims: F-R1 does not create a smooth tangent at a table node.
F-R1 does not qualify exact-on-node endpoint state handling.
F-R1 does not qualify multi-node or multi-component seam jumps.
F-R1 does not qualify saturation, heterogeneity, groundwater, H_ENPR or KSATEXM.
